ValidationRule.description: Blueprint control: Requires Proposal Date before advancing Opportunity to Proposal stage.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Proposal'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Proposal/Price Quote') ), ISBLANK(Proposal_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Proposal Date is required before advancing the Opportunity to the Proposal stage.
